props.heading: How the week runs
props.intro: Five days, one boat. Here's what happens each day.

entries.title: Meet your crew
entries.detail: Get to know your group and your mentor, and choose the boat you'll build.

entries.title: Plank the hull
entries.detail: The longest day in the boatshed. Bring a jumper, it gets cold by the water.

entries.title: Launch day
entries.detail: Every boat goes in the water at 15:00. Families are welcome to watch from the quay.
